lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Practice using kommer att for simple future predictions.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: A fika conversation about the weather forecast and how the week will probably feel.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Making neutral predictions about weather or likely outcomes.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik look at the weather forecast and talk about what will probably happen tomorrow or this weekend.

main_focus.name: kommer att for predictions
main_focus.description: Use kommer att plus infinitive for neutral predictions, especially about weather or likely results.
model_examples: Det kommer att bli kallare på söndag.
Bussen kommer att vara sen om det snöar.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use kommer att naturally 3-5 times in the dialogue.

vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use weather prediction chunks and keep the predictions concrete.

dialogue_shape.middle: They discuss likely weather and how it may affect ordinary plans.
dialogue_shape.ending: They end with uncertainty or a small adjustment.

target_complexity.repetition: contrast planned ska only lightly; keep kommer att as the main focus

focus: how the prediction affects a possible plan
the degree of certainty in the conversation

sentence_focus: one sentence with Det kommer att regna
one sentence with kommer att bli
one sentence with förmodligen or nog
one sentence about a plan affected by weather
